task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch log event and extract the timestamp, log level, and message using a regular expression
solution_criteria: The regex should correctly capture timestamp (ISO 8601 format), log level (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG), and the remaining message text from a CloudWatch log line

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS S3 bucket name and returns True if it follows AWS naming conventions (lowercase, alphanumeric and hyphens only, 3-63 characters)
solution_criteria: Function must validate bucket name length, allowed characters (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens), and return a boolean result

task: Create a JSON CloudFormation template fragment for an AWS IAM policy that allows read-only access to a specific S3 bucket
solution_criteria: JSON must include proper IAM policy structure with Effect, Action, and Resource fields; actions should be limited to s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket
